entries.german:
Hans von Hardheim verkauft seinem Bruder Jörg von Hardheim und dessen Ehefrau Walburga von Rosenberg seinen Teil des Schlosses und Vorhofs zu Hardheim um 600 Gulden.

Laufzeit: 1462 Mai 24 (1462 Montag vor Christi Himmelfahrt)
entries.english:
Hans von Hardheim sells his share of the castle and outer court at Hardheim to his brother Jörg von Hardheim and his wife Walpurga von Rosenberg for 600 guilders.

Date: May 24, 1462 (1462 Monday before Ascension)

facts.content: bought with her husband Georg von Hardheim his brother Hans von Hardheim’s share of the castle and outer court at Hardheim.
